2115824730238333225.en_summary: Sentimentrader notes $EIS fell 4.86% on Oct. 28 as sentiment toward Israeli stocks plunged from 86.28 to 15.32, the largest single-session sentiment drop in 1,966 daily changes since 2019 (with chart).
2115824730238333225.zh_summary: Sentimentrader 指出 $EIS 在 10 月 28 日下跌 4.86%，以色列股票情緒從 86.28 急降至 15.32，為 2019 年以來 1966 次日變化中單日情緒最大跌幅（附圖）。

2115825110703825278.en_summary: Mr_Derivatives says $GOOGL is furthest from its 50-day and 200-day moving averages since the April 2025 Liberation Day lows, and among the furthest from its lower Bollinger Bands in history; he would stuff it in a long-term portfolio and revisit in 12 months.
2115825110703825278.zh_summary: Mr_Derivatives 表示 $GOOGL 距 50 日與 200 日均線的幅度為 2025 年 4 月解放日低點以來最大，且為歷史上距布林帶下軌最遠之一；他主張放入長期組合，十二個月後再看。

ticker_notes.GOOGL: 偏離均線後建議長倉持有一年

2115826491489390827.en_summary: Sentimentrader says the trust behind $SLV kept adding silver as price slid toward a 1-year low, but price has been the more useful clue: when holdings momentum turned negative near a 1-year low, 7 of 8 cases with a positive 5-day price change were higher a month later, while flat or falling price was far weaker; SLV's 5-day change is still negative (with chart).
2115826491489390827.zh_summary: Sentimentrader 表示 $SLV 背後信託在銀價跌向一年低位時仍在增持，但價格更有參考價值：持倉動能在一年低位附近轉負時，五日漲幅為正的八例中七例一個月後更高，價格持平或下跌則弱得多；SLV 五日變化仍為負（附圖）。

2115827826901623145.en_summary: Mr_Derivatives notes $RDDT is down 7 days in a row and 11 of the last 13, downhill since the S&P 500 addition, and imagines a relief rally off today's earnings print.
2115827826901623145.zh_summary: Mr_Derivatives 指出 $RDDT 連跌 7 日且近 13 日有 11 日下跌，自納入標普 500 後一路走弱，並預期今日財報後或有反彈。
